items.label: Low Maintenance & Easy Assembly
items.value: This rocking fire pit chair is easy to clean with just soap and water—no painting or staining needed. Simple assembly and weather-resistant performance make it a convenient and stylish choice for your deck, lawn, or porch.

items.label: Relaxing Adirondack rocking chair
items.value: Enjoy the gentle motion of our Outdoor Rocking Adirondack Chairs, designed for peaceful moments by the firepit or under the stars. This Rocking Fire Pit Chair offers a soothing rocking experience perfect for patios, gardens, and backyard lounging.

items.label: All-Weather HDPE Construction
items.value: Made from durable HDPE material, this Adirondack chair plastic outdoor is resistant to moisture, UV rays, and fading. It won’t splinter or peel like wood—ideal for year-round outdoor use in any climate.

items.label: Wide Backrest & Ergonomic Design
items.value: With a high, slatted back and wide seat, this Adirondack chair outdoor provides exceptional comfort and support. The classic shape of our adirondack chairs is paired with a modern rocking base for enhanced relaxation.

items.label: 350 LB Weight Capacity & Sturdy Build
items.value: Built for strength, this Adirondack chair supports up to 350 LBS with a stable base that ensures secure rocking. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning coffee or hosting guests, it’s the perfect any outdoor setup.
